TAL_DARK_DARKVISION.why: A Meld: while it is one of its user's active Melds (several at once: the owner struck the printed one-Meld limit on 2026-09-29) -- the first Meld a fight starts with, or "Meld: Darkvision" -- Darkvision 60 feet (+30 if it already has Darkvision): it sees through plain Darkness within range, 5 feet inside Pure Darkness (combat/senses.py). The 2 CP augment to 120 feet is the GM's.

BLOOD_BASE_BLOODSENSE.why: Bloodsense's live range gates observer-only direction, visible injury, one-hour exposed spill, authored likely corpse cause and studied-sample comparison (combat/ext/bloodsense.py). Missing provenance remains unknown; Invisible requires freshly spilled same-source blood or another qualifying sense. No targeting sight or team knowledge is granted.

TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_TRUE_SIGHT.why: While it holds Martial Focus: Truesight 120 feet -- it sees through magical darkness and sees hidden and invisible creatures within range, not through walls (combat/senses.py).

TAL_DARK_RAPID_MELD.why: This former augment has no separate effect now that Meld takes one Action; the owner edit strikes it from the printed text.

TAL_DARK_PERSISTENT_MELD.why: "Meld: <talent> (Persistent)" costs 2 CP more and holds no Concentration (combat/ext/docket_senses.py).

TAL_GLASS_CLEAN_BREAK.why: Only when it reduces a Glass Surface, fragile object, mirror, window, crystal or mundane glass item to 0 HP: the table has no glass objects to break (the GM applies the choice).

TAL_FLOWERS_LAYERED_BOUQUET.why: "Shape Fragrance: <talent> + <talent>" offers every pair of two different Fragrance talents it knows; the next Fragrance carries both, paying both talents' costs and Layered Bouquet's 2 CP (combat/factory_compiler.py _zone_shapes, combat/zones.py _shaped).

TAL_FENCING_SKEWER.why: "Skewer: also <Exploit>" names a second Exploit; when an Exploit lands and the second differs, Martial Focus is expended and it lands too (combat/ext/needle.py apply_exploit; the toggles are combat/ext/docket_allowances.py). Without a standing pick the character is asked which two, when it holds Martial Focus.

TAL_SCOUNDREL_DOUBLE_DIP.why: "Double Dip: also <effect>" names a second Dirty Trick effect; a successful Dirty Trick with a different one expends Martial Focus and adds it (combat/ext/docket_allowances.py).
